paper.citation: Zuo, S., Ghosh, D., Ding, P. and Yang, F. (2025). Mediation Analysis with the Mediator and Outcome Missing Not at Random. Journal of the American Statistical Association 120(550), 794–804. DOI: 10.1080/01621459.2024.2359132.
paper.venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association
paper.source_locator: Published paper §5.1, Setting C and Assumption III; numeric coefficients in author arXiv:2212.05577v3 supplemental Table S1, PDF p.72 (zero-index 71), lines 3984–4006.

mechanism.name: Continuous mediation with MNAR mediator and outcome

generation_equations.label: Observed export
generation_equations.expression: M_obs0=R_M*M; Y_obs0=R_Y*Y; include R_M,R_Y to distinguish missing from genuine zero

sampling.dependence: IID X,T,error terms and missingness uniforms; within unit M->Y and M->R_M, Y->R_Y

assumptions: Randomized treatment and independent structural errors
Sequential ignorability for full-data potential outcomes conditional on X
Missingness depends on unobserved M and Y as specified; observed-only identification depends on the paper's extra conditions

properties.notes: Continuous M,Y with T*M outcome interaction and logistic MNAR missingness; exported fill values must be interpreted jointly with R_M/R_Y.

estimand.name: NIE_1
estimand.definition: E[Y(1,M(1))-Y(1,M(0))] in the full-data law before MNAR masking.

truth.expression: E[Y(1,M(1))-Y(1,M(0))] in the full-data law before MNAR masking.
truth.derivation: Exact structural effect alpha_t(beta_m+beta_mt)=2; confirmed by coupled-potential construction.

adaptations: Choose the published Setting C / Assumption III and the non-null column of Table S1; the other support and missingness settings are separate scenarios, not counted here.
Export only observed, numeric columns: M_obs0=R_M*M and Y_obs0=R_Y*Y, together with response flags; zero is a transport fill value, not an imputed datum. Full latent M,Y are never returned.
Target full-data natural indirect effect at treatment 1, derived analytically as alpha_t(beta_m+beta_mt)=2; source simulation reports effects but this exact truth is independently computed here.
warnings: No explicit latent-variable metadata or reliably identifiable latent declarations; absence from this list does not prove that no latent variables exist.
